scope: Independent review of borrowed first-block adoption, inactive physical access, explicit index acquisition, highwater and lifetime integration into two-domain storage. No engine, installed file or game access. Historical single-ledger prototype and prior reviews unchanged.
checks: All first-block pointers remain borrowed: no construction/destruction/free callback; owned suffix rollback and teardown use reverse order.
Two independently rebuilt free chains retain distinct occupancy, generation and highwater; explicit index acquisition removes exactly one free-chain entry.

Adoption validates five non-null nonoverlapping nonoverflowing ranges, duplicate/out-of-range indices and empty/open state before publishing capacity. Metadata allocation exceptions precede state publication.
Shared read leases retain State and borrowed owner; both explicit close and final State destruction clear owned suffixes before releasing original owner.
Physical access deliberately permits inactive records but rejects invalid pool, closed state and indices beyond capacity; it does not establish Agent occupancy or ownership.

coverage: 2040 -> 4080 -> 6120 five-pool stable addresses and independent domains
75 baseline suffix fault points plus 75 adopted suffix fault points
66049 indices per domain, signed16 and unsigned16 boundaries
borrowed inactive records, explicit5000 admission in both domains, independent highwater shrink
invalid adoption inputs, closed accesses, read barrier and lease-held destruction

tests.coverage: Independent two-vector model of mixed acquire/acquire_at/release/grow/current, per-domain live/highwater/generation, all five physical objects each step, borrowed lifetime retained through owned destructor callbacks
tests.output: PASS independent 10000-operation two-domain model: acquire/acquire_at/release/grow/current/highwater/physical; borrowed owner outlives all suffix destruction

limitations: Synthetic records/callbacks only: actual native allocator replacement, engine lifetime barrier and authoritative occupancy snapshots remain unimplemented.

Borrowed buffers size/alignment/lifetime and callback nonreentrancy are caller contracts; numeric range checks cannot prove them. Generation imports begin at1 and do not decode native generation metadata.
Free indices are rebuilt in ascending order, not imported native ordering. acquire_at and highwater shrink can scan O(capacity); no engine-scale performance claim.
Read lease must cover entire native record access; resolver-only lease is insufficient. Physical access bypasses domain/occupied checks intentionally.
Secondary companion relationship remains unproven; domain1 permits only pool1.
